item.title: Closing the loop: From network policy intent to verified reality
item.description: Declaring network policy is only half the battle. This post covers common mistakes that undermine network policy intent, the importance of verifying real behavior at runtime, and the design-test-deploy-observe loop that underpins the Zero Trust Validated Pattern.

item.title: Can't Patch Fast Enough? Zero Trust as a Last Line of Defense
item.description: Network policies in the Layered Zero Trust Validated Pattern provide containment when vulnerabilities are discovered faster than patches can be applied. This post introduces the approach and links to the full Red Hat blog article.
